project.title: BAKEBOX-AI: Autonomous AI Bakery Management & Customer Support (CHOCO AI)
project.short_description: Enterprise autonomous AI bakery platform powered by IBM Db2 12.1 — unifying native VECTOR(384, FLOAT32) search with BSON metadata pushdown (DB2LlamaVS), 3-Way Reciprocal Rank Fusion (k=60) + Hinglish CRAG + Self-RAG, Db2-hydrated session buffers, quantity-scaled Multi-Level Recursive BOM CTE, row-level concurrency locking (FOR UPDATE WITH RS + SP_RESERVE_CAKE_STOCK), SEQ_BB_ORDER_ID sequence allocation, keyed HMAC-SHA256 BB_AUDIT_LOG, and a hardened FastAPI REST API + interactive /demo playground.
project.category: AI / RAG / Data Engineering / Enterprise Security

members.name: Ayush Dhangar
members.role: BTech CSE-AIML, 4th Year | AI Systems & Db2 Solutions Architect

ibm_db2.edition: Db2 Community Edition 12.1 (Docker / VS Code Extension - IBMDB201)
features_used: Native VECTOR(384, FLOAT32) Column with COSINE Similarity & SYSTOOLS.BSON2JSON Metadata Pushdown
3-Way Hybrid Reciprocal Rank Fusion (DB2LlamaVS + Okapi BM25 + TF-IDF) + Hinglish CRAG
Quantity-Scaled In-Database Multi-Level Recursive BOM CTE (UNION ALL DECIMAL(10,4) Typed Parameters)
Native Db2 SQL PL Stored Procedure (SP_RESERVE_CAKE_STOCK WHERE CURRENT OF WITH RS) & SEQ_BB_ORDER_ID Sequence
Single-UOW ACID Order Transaction (Scaled BOM -> Stock Lock -> SEQ_BB_ORDER_ID -> BB_ORDERS/ITEMS -> BB_AUDIT_LOG)
Keyed HMAC-SHA256 Hash-Chained Append-Only Audit Trail (BB_AUDIT_LOG with Sealed UTC Timestamp)
Sargable Normalized Indexing (phone_last10 B-Tree Index), Masked SQL Views & IP-Partitioned 2FA Rate Limiter
Least-Privilege Db2 RBAC Roles (sql/least_privilege_setup.sql) & X-Operator-Key API Guard
Snapshot-Rollback PEP 249 MockDb2 & Cosine Simulator + Opt-In Live Db2 Integration Smoke Test

ai_models: Google Gemini 1.5 Flash (google-genai SDK with Offline Fallback)
